description: Agent Control: submit an agent registry or inventory (each agent with its aliases, owner, purpose, access scope and status) and the deployment, usage, credential or billing lists it should cover. The signed report names every agent those lists show with no registry entry, every entry with no named owner, every entry nothing else shows as active or listed retired while a list shows it running, and each field the registry is missing to be authoritative (owner, purpose, access scope, status). Verdict not_authoritative, incomplete or authoritative. POST /api/agent-registry-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-control-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-control/.
